title: GST portal (www.gst.gov.in)
source: Placeholder: no capture yet. Pages and selectors come from a recorder capture made under docs/specs/vcfo-assist-agents/PORTAL-CAPTURE.md.
notes: The GST user agreement allows access only through interfaces GSTN has authorised and calls scraping an offence under IT Act s.43 (legal review, row 17). Needs a CS opinion before any capture or live use.
Until then a GST agent only prepares the data in Suite; the person types it into the portal. The extension has no host permission for gst.gov.in.
